messages:
ivy: Quick note from the onboarding session: if you kill the JS sample app while a stream is active we sometimes get malformed JSON in the UI. Looks like partial SSE events are being surfaced on shutdown.
sam: Can you paste the minimal repro and any logs?
ivy: Repro: run sample locally, trigger a long-running generate, then hit ctrl+c ~150-300ms after tokens start. Node/browser logs show JSON.parse errors. Snippet: 
[info] stream connected /v1/stream
[debug] recv: data: {\"text\":\" He\"
[debug] SIGTERM
[debug] flush -> \"llo\"
[error] JSON.parse failed: Unexpected end of JSON input

ivy: Browser shows a parse error and the UI renders a truncated object. Python sample prints \"truncated token\" and exits non-zero.
devon: Sounds like parser.finalize() is emitting leftover buffer even if it doesn't end with the SSE delimiter (\n\n). If auth refresh triggers a reconnect concurrently we can get duplicated half-chunks.
sam: Two quick fixes: 1) parser: on finalize only emit if buffer contains a full SSE event (endsWith('\n\n') or has a complete 'data:' block). Otherwise drop and debug-log. 2) sampleapps: implement gracefulShutdown on SIGINT/SIGTERM that polls parser.inFlight for up to 150ms before force-close; fallback env var DEMO_STRICT_PARSING=false for demos. Also catch JSON.parse from stream handlers and show a friendly notice like \"Stream ended early: partial output omitted\" instead of crashing.
devon: I'll add unit tests for mid-chunk abort and an integration that simulates auth refresh + client abort.
ops-bot: deploy note: no blocking deploys; small PRs OK to merge.
ivy: Thanks 12 I'll open small PRs for the JS + Python sampleapps and the parser change. Tagging @sam for review and will include a short repro script for docs.
